datePolicy: All registered source access dates are explicitly 2026-11-06 in retained sources.md. NMBA effective date 2025-03-18, score transition 2026-04-23 and Home Affairs tables from 2025-08-07 are separate. ETS bulletin covers July 2026–June 2027; the retrieved legislation ends 2026-10-31. USEF fee is May 2019, not current. Authoring is not a source refresh or publication.
uncertainties: Visa subclass unspecified; OSR acceptance, full-test combination acceptance and post-October legislative currency remain unresolved.
No guaranteed comparative easiest test, pass probability, nursing qualification acceptance, skills assessment or visa eligibility.
No April 2027 seats, final fees, complete current street venue inventory or verified nearest foreign fallback. ULCI and USEF are preliminary operator leads only.
TOEFL Nepal Australia-test base fee unknown; USD 180 is explicitly May 2019. Global TOEFL version and 1–6 scale must not be substituted for Australia.
OET fee and change conditions rely on official indexed support text; final Nepal debit/FX/taxes unconfirmed.
PTE dedicated cancellation policy uses more than 14 days, despite looser FAQ wording. IDP current binding cancellation terms unconfirmed; BC terms must not transfer.
Source memos contain differing ULCI extraction and ETS URL/version observations; final retained guide and source synthesis used with their explicit limits.

Original research had automatic managed-browser/search fallbacks; clean-session status not certified. No account creation, booking, payment or contact reported. This authoring made no external request.
